decisions.reason: A reference electrometer sits at the core of the firm's dosimetry business, is featured on the home page, costs little to keep on the market and still shows strong value.

The oncology risk management software supports the strategic shift toward integrated, predictive QA, and its uncertain but promising value justifies holding the option at the low carrying cost of software.
The CT image quality phantom launched only in 2024, extends the established imaging QA line, and is cheap to maintain while its market value is still unresolved.
This mammography phantom is distant from the core business and overlaps with Product E, so it could be consolidated, but it launched recently and its uncertainty has not yet resolved.
The full field mammography phantom is new and the uncertainty about it is unresolved, and keeping it costs little, although its distance from the core business and overlap with D add some drop risk.
The broad imaging QA instrument line builds on established capabilities and fits the expansion strategy, so it remains a valuable open option.
